description: Single-panel dynamic recrystallization (DRX) state diagram, plotted with lnZ (Zener–Hollomon parameter, dimensionless) on the vertical axis (labelled ticks 50, 60, 70) against strain ε on the horizontal axis (labelled ticks 0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9). Two datasets are overlaid, each with a fitted line: open black circles, legend "Critical strain εc", and red stars, legend "Steady-state strain εs". The εc circles lie on a steep, nearly vertical black curve that rises from about lnZ 52 at ε ≈ 0.05 to about lnZ 71 at ε ≈ 0.25. The εs stars fall on a gently rising red straight line running from roughly (ε ≈ 0.22, lnZ ≈ 53) to (ε ≈ 0.9, lnZ ≈ 70). Three text annotations divide the plot: "A-work hardening" upper left, "B-partial DRX" in the band between the two curves, and "C-complete DRX" lower right. The figure demonstrates that for this Fe–Mn–Al–C steel both the critical strain εc and the steady-state strain εs increase with lnZ, and it maps the work-hardening, partial-DRX and complete-DRX domains as functions of lnZ and ε. No numeric values are printed beside any data point.

observations.observation: The figure is a single scatter plot with lnZ on the ordinate (tick labels 50, 60, 70) and strain ε on the abscissa (tick labels 0.0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9); no units are printed on either axis.
The legend distinguishes two series: open black circles labelled "Critical strain εc" and red stars labelled "Steady-state strain εs".
A steep near-vertical fitted black curve passes through the εc circles, whereas a straight red line with shallow positive slope is fitted through the εs stars.
Three text annotations label regions of the plot: "A-work hardening" in the upper left, "B-partial DRX" in the band between the two fitted lines, and "C-complete DRX" in the lower right.
The εc data points occupy a narrow strain range of roughly ε = 0.05 to 0.25 while lnZ varies from about 52 to about 71, giving the curve its near-vertical geometry.
The εs data points increase monotonically with lnZ, extending from about (ε ≈ 0.22, lnZ ≈ 53) to about (ε ≈ 0.9, lnZ just above 70).
No numeric value is printed next to any individual data point; only the axis tick values are given.
The caption states the panel is a "Dynamic recrystallization state diagram for the steel under hot deformation".
The citing text defines area A as the zone of work hardening, area B as the zone of partial DRX and area C as the zone of complete DRX.

The citing text states that with increasing Z parameter (increasing strain rate or decreasing temperature) the εc and εs of dynamic recrystallization increase, so that starting and completing DRX of the steel becomes more difficult.
The citing text states the diagram was drawn from the relationship between εc, εs and the Z parameter for Fe–Mn–Al–C steel.
The paper abstract states the hot deformation conditions studied are T = 900–1150 °C and strain rate 0.01–10 s⁻¹; the figure itself does not print these conditions.

unreadable_items: No printed data values exist; all point coordinates are read relative to axis gridlines only and are therefore approximations, not exact numbers.
